title: Transfer of development rights from Theater Subdistrict
previewText: For zoning lots abutting the Theater Subdistrict of the Special Midtown District, the boundaries for which are shown in Map 1 of Appendix A of Article VIII Chapter 1, the provisions of Section 81-744 (Transfer of development rights from listed theaters) may be applied and such zoning lots may be “receiving sites” as defined in such section.
